SHIPPED.bench.machine_quiescence: enumerates every process via ps and returns each one over a CPU or RSS threshold, with quiet, contenders, total_cpu_pct and max_rss_gib as FIELDS a receipt can carry
SHIPPED.THERE_IS_DELIBERATELY_NO_NAMES_PARAMETER: the blind spot WAS a filter, so the fix must not ship a filter. An instrument whose blind spot is configurable is one somebody will configure blind. A test asserts the signature is exactly {cpu_pct, rss_gib} and FAILS if a names= is ever added.
SHIPPED.RSS_IS_THE_GATE_NOT_CPU_AND_THE_REASON_I: this campaign sealed on 2026-08-22 that METAL WORKING SET is this machine's admission gate and NOT free RAM, so a large-RSS neighbour contends with a resident model in the dimension that decides. CPU is reported because it is real, not because it is equally predictive.
SHIPPED.the_caller_is_not_exempt: the harness's own process is reported like any other. Excluding it would be the same self-exemption the name filter made by accident, and a benchmark burning CPU is a fact about the measurement.
SHIPPED.bench.name_filter_quiescence: THE BROKEN CHECK, KEPT EXECUTABLE as the control, with a docstring saying never to decide admissibility with it -- because a refutation nobody has watched is indistinguishable from a rule nobody needed

A_FAILED_ENUMERATION_IS_NOT_A_QUIET_MACH.rule: if ps exits non-zero, quiet is None and a `refused` reason is recorded -- NEVER True
A_FAILED_ENUMERATION_IS_NOT_A_QUIET_MACH.why: 0 of 0 reads identically to 0 of many. 'I could not look' and 'I looked and found nothing' are different facts, and this program has already confused them four times.

claim_boundary: THIS DETECTS CONTENTION; IT DOES NOT ATTRIBUTE SLOWNESS TO IT. The 42x capability stall and the 3-of-12 decoder outliers remain UNEXPLAINED -- this instrument would have RECORDED which processes were present, not proven they caused anything. Naming a contender is not naming a cause.

THE THRESHOLDS ARE CHOICES, NOT MEASUREMENTS. 20% CPU and 2 GiB are set by judgement; a contender under both is invisible, and nothing here establishes that a process below them cannot perturb a measurement.

ps pcpu ON macOS IS A DECAYED AVERAGE over the process's life, not an instantaneous sample, so a process that spiked and stopped reads low and one that just started reads low too. The RSS column has no such lag, which is a second reason to prefer it.

NOT WIRED INTO time_arm AUTOMATICALLY, and the reason is cost not principle: time_arm is called hundreds of times inside a sweep and a subprocess per call would be real overhead that could itself perturb the thing being measured. So a caller must attach it, WHICH MEANS THE OLD FAILURE MODE -- forgetting to check -- IS STILL POSSIBLE. Named rather than papered over.
NO TIMED CLAIM ANYWHERE IN THIS PROGRAM IS RETROACTIVELY VALIDATED by this. Every prior receipt's quiescence evidence is still the sentence it always was.
One machine, macOS ps. Nothing timed; no kernel changed; no performance claim moves.
